hypothesis: Fixed source-surface CoTracker correspondence may stabilize rigid orientation beyond independent silhouette/depth initialization; absolute source depth is inherited.
source: earliest observed run03 frame; use only original manual/grid tracks whose query time equals source; tracker visible and within one-pixel-eroded object mask; front-most triangle ray hit creates immutable canonical anchor
per_frame_gate: same immutable IDs, tracker visibility, one-pixel-eroded target object mask, finite coordinates, >=6 points, nondegenerate canonical and image spread

bundle.track_residual: pixel error / (3 * sqrt(number of valid correspondences))
bundle.rotation_prior: 0.05 * rotation difference to run03 in radians
bundle.translation_acceleration: actual-dt velocity change / mean dt / 10 m/s^2
bundle.rotation_acceleration: actual-dt relative rotation velocity change / mean dt / 80 rad/s^2

missing_observations: no track residual, zero observation reliability; weak initialization and actual-dt temporal priors only, never counted as new evidence
budget: one fit, no sweep, hard <=600 seconds CPU; save explicit gate failure if source or tracks are degenerate; no training dispatch
evaluation: after prediction and hashes frozen, reuse same 14-slot centroid/template identity/direct source-ray query proxy without alignment; proxy is not Gaussian rendered query
